title: Horizon Launches Fourteenth Unit of FD100 Series
description: Horizon Yachts launches the 14th FD100 hull, featuring a customized minimalist interior, tri-deck layout, and robust Caterpillar power.
html:
The latest addition to the Fast Displacement series features a customized minimalist interior.

Fourteenth Hull of FD100 Series Hits Water

Horizon Yachts has officially launched the fourteenth unit of its FD100 model, a significant milestone for the Taiwan-based builder’s Fast Displacement series. Designed with the American market in mind, this latest launch features the distinct exterior styling of Cor D. Rover, characterized by floor-to-ceiling windows and a high-volume profile. The vessel utilizes a tri-deck configuration, offering expanded living spaces across three levels while maintaining a gross tonnage suitable for owner-operation or a small crew.

The engineering platform remains consistent with previous hulls, utilizing Horizon’s proprietary High Performance Piercing Bow to improve efficiency and stability. This specific unit, however, distinguishes itself through a heavily customized interior design tailored to specific owner preferences. The launch highlights the shipyard’s capacity for semi-custom production, where a proven technical platform supports varied interior layouts and finishings.

Minimalist European Styling Defines Interior

The interior of Hull 14 departs from traditional nautical themes, adopting a design language described as European minimalism. The primary materials include natural dyed oak and Mikado Calacatta Fantasy quartz, selected to create a neutral and open atmosphere. In the main salon, a wood-grain parquet table serves as the focal point, capable of adjusting height and retracting to suit different social occasions. A stone-topped bar and moveable sofas allow the space to transition easily between formal dining and casual lounging.

Privacy and functionality are addressed through smart layout choices, such as a Hi-Lo wavy glass partition that separates the galley from the dining area. The accommodation layout includes a full-beam master stateroom on the main deck, featuring custom woodwork and Italian Patagonia stone in the ensuite. Four additional guest cabins are located on the lower deck, comprising two VIP suites, a double, and a twin, all accessed via a staircase detailed with backlit gray mirrors.

Tri-Deck Configuration Maximizes Outdoor Living

The tri-deck design allocates significant square footage to exterior entertainment areas, a key demand in the current market. The upper deck houses an enclosed skylounge that functions as a climate-controlled retreat, complete with a wet bar and wine cabinets. Just aft of this space, an alfresco dining area accommodates ten guests under the protection of a hardtop, supported by a concealed barbeque station and flexible seating arrangements.

The uppermost deck offers a dedicated leisure zone, equipped with a Jacuzzi, integrated sun pads, and a rotating 55-inch television for entertainment. At the stern, the beach club area has been configured as a hybrid space, incorporating a bar and wet storage to support water sports activities. This area connects directly to the swim platform, facilitating easy access to the water and tender operations.

Performance Capabilities and Market Availability

Power is provided by twin Caterpillar C32A diesel engines, each generating 1,900 horsepower, which allow the vessel to reach speeds in the range of 21 knots. The mechanical package includes zero-speed stabilization to ensure comfort at anchor and underway. Crew quarters are positioned aft of the engine room, providing accommodation for up to five crew members, ensuring professional service levels can be maintained during extended voyages.

Following its launch and final outfitting, the fourteenth FD100 is scheduled for delivery to the United States. The vessel exemplifies the continued demand for high-volume yachts in the 100-foot segment, balancing extensive amenities with the practical requirements of range and seaworthiness. This unit reinforces the series’ position in the competitive composite superyacht sector.

Intelligence synthesized from: horizonyacht.com, yachtbuyer.com.
